title: The Last Confession Anew
author: Ivo Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Yarrow, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
